name: Eight planar points maximizing the product of distances at fixed diameter
description: construct() -> 8 distinct points [x, y] (floats, |coordinate| < 10^6). The score is Delta/n^n, where Delta is the product over ordered pairs of distances after scaling the set to diameter 2; the regular octagon scores exactly 1. Maximize. Scores above 1 beat the regular octagon; the paper's constructions show this is possible, but no value for n = 8 is recorded here.

sources.locator: Stijn Cambie, Aron Decadt, Yanting Dong, Tianchi Hu and Quanyu Tang, On the maximum product of distances of diameter 2 point sets (2026). arXiv abstract inspected (extremal sets are convex polygons; constructions drastically improve on regular n-gons for even n); Erdős Problem #1045 page inspected: the regular polygon gives Delta = n^n for even n and is not optimal for even n >= 4 (Hu and Tang; Cambie), and liminf max Delta/n^n >= 1.268 for even n. Scores above 1 beat the regular octagon; the paper's constructions show this is possible, but no value for n = 8 is recorded here.
Erdős Problem #1045 (open); statement, history and current bounds reviewed 2026-09-24.
JSP-000867; pinned discovery source, independently paraphrased. Primary mathematical attribution follows the papers above.
